description: Payment-by-payment breakdown of how a loan is repaid, showing the split between principal and interest and the falling balance. Use granularity 'monthly' for the first years in detail, 'yearly' for a whole-term overview. Also reports how much sooner extra principal pays the loan off.

inputSchema.description: Amortization schedule showing how each payment splits between principal and interest.

annualInsurance.description: Annual homeowners insurance premium in US dollars.

annualInterestRatePercent.description: Annual nominal interest rate as a percentage, for example 6.5 for 6.5%.

downPaymentPercent.description: Down payment as a percentage of the purchase price, 0 to 100. Not a dollar amount.

granularity.description: Yearly returns one row per year; monthly returns one row per payment, up to 600 rows.

homePrice.description: Purchase price of the home in US dollars.

loanTermYears.description: Loan term in years. Most US mortgages are 15 or 30.

loanType.description: Loan programme. Affects mortgage insurance and upfront fees.

monthlyExtraPrincipal.description: Additional principal paid each month. Shortens the loan rather than lowering the payment.

monthlyHoa.description: Monthly homeowners association dues in US dollars.

propertyTaxRatePercent.description: Annual property tax as a percentage of home value. Omit and pass `state` instead to use that state's average.

state.description: Full US state name, for example "Texas". Used to look up the average property tax rate. Either this or propertyTaxRatePercent is required.

name: calculate_amortization

outputSchema.description: Repayment schedule for one mortgage scenario, by month or by year.

disclaimer.description: Estimate-only notice that should accompany any figure shown to a person.

interestSaved.description: Interest avoided through extra principal, in dollars.

paymentsMade.description: Number of payments until the loan is repaid.

rows.description: Schedule rows in order. Fields vary with granularity.

scheduledPayments.description: Number of payments on the original schedule.

totalInterestPaid.description: Interest paid over the life of the loan, in dollars.

title: Build an amortization schedule
